definition: The group of words that name the layers the system is built in, each a precondition for the one above it, from the alphabet of elements up to the interfaces a person uses.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`layer` holds the layers of the architecture, each a precondition for the one above it", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
